description.text: The German print of the McDonald's set for Pokémon's 25th anniversary: Pikachu and the first partner Pokémon of every region, 25 cards each in a non-holo and a holo copy, with the anniversary logo. In Germany they came from 11 March 2021, in sealed four-card packs given with Happy Meals.
